source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Security Tools and Techniques (PDF 126, printed 122).

blocks.text: Security tools aur techniques computers aur networks ko online khatron se bachate hain. Yeh hackers ya nuqsan-deh (malicious) software ke liye zaroori maloomat tak pohanchna mushkil bana dete hain. In tools mein authentication systems (pehchan ki tasdeeq), firewalls aur antivirus programs shamil hain jo nuqsan-deh kaam check kar ke rokte hain. Inhein sahi tarah use karna zaati data mehfooz rakhta hai aur cyberattacks ka imkaan kam karta hai. Har computer user ko digital safety ke liye yeh tools samajhne aur use karne chahiyein.

blocks.alt: Beech mein 'Aap ka data' (taale ke saath), us se chaar dabbe jure: Firewall (nuqsandeh traffic roke), IDS (mashkook amal par khabar), Antivirus (virus aur malware hataye), 2FA aur biometrics (shanakht ki tasdeeq). Koi tarteeb nahi; sab mil kar kaam karte hain.
blocks.caption: Security ke tools mil kar data bachate hain (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.prompt: Kitab teen security tools ke naam leti hai. Kaun se?
blocks.explanation: Authentication systems (pehchan ki tasdeeq), firewalls aur antivirus programs.

items: Security tools hackers aur malicious software ke liye rasai mushkil banate hain.
Har user ko yeh tools samajhne aur use karne chahiyein.
